data.name: Duo Decide
data.whereItsAt: Voting, three-round polls, option lists, history and real-time sync work on iOS and the web. The redesign shipped in October. November went to App Store readiness: an iOS 26 build, over-the-air updates, archive and soft delete, and a native accessibility pass.

lines: Over-the-air updates, so fixes skip a store review.
Decided decisions can be archived; deletes became soft.
Native audit: a crash fix, touch targets, Dynamic Type.
Decision options became a row list, with tappable links.
A 3D yellow heart became the app icon.
Vote mode is one pick by the partner again.

shoots.label: App Store release
shoots.note: The goal: ship it on the App Store.

resolved.text: In round 3 of a poll, the partner who didn't start it makes the final pick.

shoots.label: Notifications
shoots.note: Tell you when your partner votes, or a poll moves to the next round.

shoots.label: Plan after deciding
shoots.note: Once a decision is made, plan it together: when, where, notes and links, kept in history.

shoots.label: When AI may merge
shoots.note: Open question: which tests and checks let the AI pipeline merge a change without review?
